visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight extreme close-up of a wooden spoon drizzling a rich, glistening, reddish-brown braised pork sauce (Rou Zao) onto a mound of steaming white rice in a white porcelain bowl. Bright, warm indoor lighting emphasizes the oily sheen and meaty texture of the sauce. (2) A ladle pours dark herbal chicken soup into a bowl, splashing over sliced ginger and pieces of chicken. The background shows a clean restaurant counter with metallic pots. (3) A soft-boiled egg with a pale, pinkish-white surface is held by a white ceramic spoon. It is placed gently atop the meat-sauce rice. (4) A pair of black-gloved hands uses red chopsticks to stir a large, simmering industrial-sized pot of braised pork, revealing countless small cubes of fat and meat in a bubbling dark sauce. (5) The camera returns to a close-up of the meat sauce being applied to rice. (6) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a brown top, carries a brown tray containing four bowls of food through a well-lit indoor dining space. (7) A close-up shot shows a spoon scooping the rice, sauce, and a fragment of egg. (8) A bowl of braised pork rice is shown prominently on a table. (9) Chopsticks break the soft-boiled egg, and the vibrant orange-yellow liquid yolk flows down, coating the braised meat and white rice. (10) A large, thick piece of braised pork belly (Tui Ku) is shown on a bed of rice, accompanied by green pickled mustard greens and a slice of red chili. (11) A spoon lifts a porous, steamed egg custard from a bowl of light yellow soup. (12) Small side dishes, including purple eggplant with scallions, liver slices, and pumpkin, are presented on a wooden table. (13) A person uses chopsticks to lift a slice of eggplant topped with minced garlic and chili. (14) The camera pans across a spacious, modern restaurant interior with wooden tables, red accented walls, and patrons seated for meals. (15) A close-up of a printed menu with Chinese and English text is shown. (16) The final shot features a storefront with a large 'VASO' sign and decorative window decals.

(3) A soft squishing sound is heard when the egg yolk is broken, followed by the sound of metal clinking against porcelain. The voice continues to describe the 'sticky' texture of the rice. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy food recommendation vlog for VASO Hong Braised Pork Rice Shop in Kaohsiung. It aims to entice viewers through 'food porn' visuals of glistening fats and runny egg yolks, emphasizing the variety of soup and side dishes available, while highlighting the shop's new and bright interior to encourage visits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the shop, provides its full address and branch name, and encourages viewers to visit 'nearby'.
